translations.web: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
translations.bsb: That is why he is obligated to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
translations.kjv: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
translations.asv: and by reason thereof is bound, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
